Welcome. This site hosts the **asynchronous sessions** for 36104. The pages
are live: every code cell runs Python in your browser — nothing to install.
Edit the code, press **Run Code**, and the output updates.

## How to use these pages

1. Work through the parts of each session in order.
2. Run each code cell as you reach it; edit and re-run to experiment.
3. Where a page has an exercise, attempt it before using the hints, and
   check the solution only after making your own attempt. The **final
   exercise of each part has no solution button** — it is yours to
   build, with "how to know you got it" checks in place of an answer.

Your work here is **not saved** when you close the tab. These pages are for
working through the sessions; anything you need to submit goes through
Canvas as described in the relevant brief.
